subject: Federated VPC segmentation & capacity augmentation at renewal
messages:
From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@atlashealth.com>
To: michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: isolating environments + capacity increase request

Hi Michael,

Our renewal for Redwood is coming up on Jan 15. Over the past year our analytics and PHI-backed services have grown faster than expected, and procurement has asked us to both: 1) segment our production footprint into a federated VPC topology (per-region tenant isolation), and 2) provision dedicated edge clusters for burst capacity in the US-East and US-West zones.

High level asks:
- Isolation: separate VPCs for Analytics (PCI/PHI) and ML-feature store tenants; strict network segmentation and discrete KV caches.
- Capacity: +3 edge clusters (2 in us-east, 1 in us-west) sized for ~500 rps sustained each with 4s peak requests.
- Term: considering a 24-month committed term if pricing supports reserved capacity discounts.

Can you share an estimate for scope, lead time, and a rough price delta versus our current Dedicated plan? Procurement will need a draft SOW and an amended contract for legal review.

Thanks,
Sara Hayes
Director, Platform Ops | Atlas Health
Sara.hayes@atlashealth.com

Attachment: none in this initial note

From: michael.grant@redwood.com
To: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@atlashealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: isolating environments + capacity increase request

Sara — thanks for the clear overview. We can support a federated VPC topology and the additional edge clusters, but there are a few items we'll need to scope accurately:

- Expected token volume and average sequence length (tokens/sec) for the Analytics tenant and other tenants.
- Traffic profile (steady vs. spiky) and retention requirements for logs/kv caches.
- Any additional compliance evidence beyond SOC 2 (e.g., HIPAA BAAs).

Next steps I propose:
1) Introduce Monica (solutions engineering) for a technical sizing call this week.
2) Ben will follow up on commercial options (24-month committed discounts and reserved cluster pricing).
3) If you can send a current deployment matrix and traffic projection, Monica can draft a technical addendum and I can prepare a mutual action plan for procurement.

I've attached the current-deployment-matrix.csv I found in our portal to start filling — please replace with your numbers if you have an internal version.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com

Subject: Re: Renewal: isolating environments + capacity increase request

Thanks Michael — attaching the internal projections and a short doc the infra team put together.

Key numbers:
- Monthly active tokens (all tenants): 1.8B tokens/mo.
- Peak sustained RPS for Analytics tenant: 420 rps (10–12s windows during batch runs); average request payload ~1.1k tokens.
- Expected growth: 35% next 12 months.
- Required retention for request logs: 90 days.

Procurement note: we need a single amendment that covers both the capacity upgrade and the environment segmentation. I can take a 24-month term internally if Redwood can commit to a 15% discount on reserved cluster spend and provide documented migration windows to avoid downtime.

Attaching: traffic_projection_q1_q2.xlsx

Sara

Attachment: traffic_projection_q1_q2.xlsx

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@atlashealth.com>, michael.grant@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: isolating environments + capacity increase request

Hi Sara — Monica here (Solutions Eng). I reviewed the projection and sketched a recommended topology. High-level technical plan:

- Federated VPCs: create three isolated VPCs (analytics-prod, features-prod, shared-infra) with explicit egress rules and no cross-VPC KV sharing. We will use our private control plane and customer-managed VPC peering for admin access.
- Edge clusters: provision 3 new Dedicated clusters (2x us-east, 1x us-west) with autoscaling policies tuned for sustained 500 rps peaks. Each cluster: 8x A100-equivalent nodes (quantization-friendly build) + hot KV cache nodes.
- Migration: phased cutover over two maintenance windows per region; traffic mirroring for 10 days, then step-down to avoid cold-start latency regressions.
- Observability: enable token-level cost tracing and per-route latency SLO dashboards during migration.

Rough timeline: 6–8 weeks from signed amendment to prod cutover (includes procurement, network approvals, and validation).
Cost delta estimate: +~42% on monthly unit cost compared to current footprint (driven primarily by dedicated edge clusters). If you commit to 24-months, we can compress that to +25% with a reserved-capacity discount structure (15–18% depending on node counts).

Reqs for us to proceed:
- Confirm SOC2 report access window and any HIPAA BAA language.
- Access to a shared subnet CIDR plan to avoid overlap with your VPCs.

I'll attach a small tech sketch and a rough node-count table. Happy to run through this on a call.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: tech_design_sketch.png (stub)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Sara — appreciate the quick info and Monica's breakdown. To summarize and propose the mutual action plan:

1) Commercial: Redwood can offer a 15% reserved-capacity discount on the augmented cluster spend for a 24-month committed term (DEAL-ATH-8241). We'll size the monthly committed node hours based on Monica's node-count table and your traffic projections; over-provisioning buffer will be discussed in the SOW.

2) Legal/SOW: I'll draft an amendment that includes (a) federated VPC deployment details, (b) migration windows, (c) observability requirements, and (d) the discount schedule. Expect the draft in 48 business hours.

3) Procurement checklist: please provide SOC2 access and confirm whether a BAA is required. Procurement, once you confirm, we'll forward the DocuSign amendment link.

4) Timeline: target signed amendment by Dec 22 to hit a mid-Feb production cutover (aligns with your growth window). Implementation ETA remains 6–8 weeks post-signature.
